capabilities: Render chat conversations in code blocks as message bubbles
Align speakers left, right or center and continue multi-message turns
Render Markdown, including images and wikilinks, inside message bubbles
Render WebVTT, Zendesk and Intercom transcript exports
Keep legacy 1.x blocks working via the chat-old format
extras: The 2.0 rewrite dropped several 1.x per-block styling options (header size, max width, minimal mode, manual colors); users upgrading must rename blocks to chat-old or chat-zendesk.
intentEvidence: Version 2.0 is a full rewrite. The default chat format is new
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display conversations as chat interfaces inside notes.

relations.evidence: If you export chat transcripts from Zendesk or a similar support tool, the chat-zendesk format will render them
The chat-intercom format renders conversations in the style Intercom exports them.
Chat View can render WebVTT caption files, which is the format most meeting tools

summary: Renders chat conversations as styled message bubbles inside Markdown code blocks, with several transcript formats.
